proposal_text: Three consecutive specification-drift VETOs on the Phase 13 plan were distinct, successively narrower findings: loopback/evidence-set/non-resume gates; explanation prose; the Slice A schemas' free-text fields. They do not repeat. No gate_override, regression or capability-shortfall events are unaddressed. Process lesson: when a plan introduces a class-wide rule (here, structured-only prose), the Governor applies it to every schema in scope in the same iteration rather than to the instance the auditor named. Iteration 4 applies LD13 to all v1 task schemas.
